test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:** All shoes are leather. Some leather are belts. Some belts are gold.

**Conclusion I: **Some shoes are belts.

**Conclusion II:** All belts are gold.
solution:
**Given:**

Statement:

All shoes are leather.

Some leather are belts.

Some belts are gold.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09784da7a63edf679b47128771aa047828e324397988ae0999a400e94cab0c5f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some shoes are belts → **False **(There is no direct relation is given between shoes and belts. So, it can be possible only.)

II. All belts are gold → **False **(It is given that some belt are gold. No relation is given about all belt and gold so it can be possible only.)

So, **neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is*** 'Option 1'.***
